title: [BUG] Dual watchface displays outdated IOB values due to delayed broadcast; dev3 and dev
symptom: Dual watchface displays an outdated IOB value received from AAPSCLIENT2. IOB inside AAPSCLIENT2 is current, but the broadcasted IOB value is delayed/not synced correctly, causing the watchface to show stale IOB. BG and COB appear correct.
cause: Mixing different versions of AAPS and clients (e.g., AAPS V4 with V4Client2 broadcasting to V3Client) is not allowed; all must be the same version.
fix: Ensure all components (AAPS and clients) are the same version. The maintainer also provided a commit (fd92c243c695ada3cd093731f6ba685d2d6da8eb) that likely fixes the issue.
evidence_quote: you cannot mix versions. all must be the same
